Rich Tree View - Label editing

Source: vignettes/rich-tree-view-editing.Rmd
rich-tree-view-editing.Rmd

Original MUI X documentation: Rich Tree View - Label editing. The examples of this page are written for R.

library(muiTreeView)
library(htmltools)

The examples of this page use a selection of the functions of the muiMaterial, muiCharts and reactRouter packages, grouped by package and topic. The trees show the packages and their groups:

to_id <- function(x) gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(x))

fns <- rbind(
  data.frame(package = "muiMaterial", group = "Layout", fn = c("Box", "Stack", "Grid")),
  data.frame(package = "muiMaterial", group = "Inputs", fn = c("Button", "TextField", "Slider", "Switch")),
  data.frame(package = "muiMaterial", group = "Navigation", fn = c("Link", "Tabs", "Drawer")),
  data.frame(package = "muiMaterial", group = "Surfaces", fn = c("AppBar", "Toolbar", "Card")),
  data.frame(package = "muiCharts", group = "Charts", fn = c("BarChart", "LineChart", "PieChart", "Gauge")),
  data.frame(package = "muiCharts", group = "Building blocks", fn = c("ChartsContainer", "ChartsXAxis", "ChartsLegend", "Toolbar")),
  data.frame(package = "reactRouter", group = "Routers", fn = c("RouterProvider", "createHashRouter", "createMemoryRouter")),
  data.frame(package = "reactRouter", group = "Routes", fn = c("Route", "Outlet")),
  data.frame(package = "reactRouter", group = "Navigation", fn = c("Link", "NavLink", "Navigate")),
  data.frame(package = "reactRouter", group = "Hooks", fn = c("useParams", "useLoaderData", "useNavigate"))
)
# Stable ids, built from the path: "Navigation", "Link" and "Toolbar" exist in two packages
fns$group_id <- paste(fns$package, to_id(fns$group), sep = "-")
fns$fn_id <- paste0(fns$package, "::", fns$fn)

group_items <- asMuiTree(
  fns,
  levels = c("package", "group"),
  levels_id = c("package", "group_id")
)

Enable label editing

Use isItemEditable = TRUE to let users edit the labels. Double-click on an item, or focus it and press Enter, to edit it. Press Enter or leave the field to save, and Escape to cancel. MUI docs

RichTreeView(
  items = group_items,
  isItemEditable = TRUE,
  defaultExpandedItems = list("muiMaterial")
)

Limit editing to some items

Give a JavaScript function to isItemEditable to make only some items editable. It receives an item and returns TRUE when the item can be edited. Here, the items of the package level get an editable field in R, so only the packages can be renamed, not the groups: MUI docs

RichTreeView(
  items = asMuiTree(
    fns,
    levels = c("package", "group"),
    levels_id = c("package", "group_id"),
    package = list(editable = TRUE)
  ),
  isItemEditable = JS("(item) => Boolean(item.editable)"),
  defaultExpandedItems = list("muiMaterial")
)

Limit editing to leaves

To make only the items without children editable, check the children field: MUI docs

RichTreeView(
  items = group_items,
  isItemEditable = JS("(item) => !item.children || item.children.length === 0"),
  defaultExpandedItems = list("muiMaterial", "reactRouter")
)

Track item label change

Use onItemLabelChange to know when a label was edited. It receives the item id and the new label. In Shiny, forward them to the server with Shiny.setInputValue(), as in the example below. On this page, which runs without a Shiny server, a JS() function writes them below the tree. MUI docs

div(
  RichTreeView(
    items = group_items,
    isItemEditable = TRUE,
    defaultExpandedItems = list("muiMaterial"),
    onItemLabelChange = JS(
      "(itemId, label) => {
        document.getElementById('rtv-label').textContent = itemId + ' renamed to: ' + label;
      }"
    )
  ),
  tags$pre(tags$span(id = "rtv-label", "No label edited"))
)
No label edited

In a Shiny app, update the data frame with the new label. Like every value sent by the browser, validate it on the server:

RichTreeView(
  items = group_items,
  isItemEditable = TRUE,
  onItemLabelChange = JS(
    "(itemId, label) => Shiny.setInputValue('labelChange', { itemId, label })"
  )
)

# server
observeEvent(input$labelChange, {
  change <- input$labelChange
  req(change$itemId %in% fns$group_id, nchar(change$label) <= 50)
  ...
})

Change the default behavior

Changing how an item saves or validates its label needs a custom item component, written with JS() and the useTreeItemUtils() hook. See Rich Tree View - Customization for how to write one. MUI docs

Imperative API

The MUI imperative API (apiRef, to change a label or start editing from JavaScript) relies on a React hook, which is not available from R. MUI docs
